court: In the High Court of Madras
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. Mohamed Riyaz Additional Public Prosecutor
prayer: PRAYER: Criminal Original Petition filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, to direct the Second Respondent police to take further action on the Petitioner's complaint dated 18.11.2019 and to enquire investigate the same and to file a Final Report.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

P. Rajamanickam, J.:— This petition has been filed to direct the Second Respondent police to take further action on the Petitioner's complaint dated 18.11.2019 and to enquire investigate the same and to file a Final Report.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the respondents Police.

3. This petition is not maintainable, in view of the order passed by the Hon'ble Division Bench of this Court in Crl.OP(MD) No. 13681 of 2018 and a batch of cases, dated 20.09.2018, liberty is given to the petitioner to workout her remedy as per the direction given the Hon'ble Division Bench.

4. With the above said direction, this Criminal Original Petition is disposed of.
